compiled_state.description:
## Context
The coordinator and fuse remain inert until non-create families route through them. Cutover must preserve independent work, explicitly defer matching plans, and prove the new fuse would not have prematurely stopped historical successful or partially successful jobs.

## Outcome
Make typed coordination authoritative for non-create families behind an internal per-family rollback selector, persist explicit deferral metadata, add the new endpoint-failure scoped fuse (retaining the blast-radius mass-mutation guard `classify.check_blast_radius`), and emit exact pass outcomes.

## Plan
1. Venue-gate verified-fake Cloud/DC summary behavior, then change the internal operation-family default from legacy to coordinator; never dual-send.
2. Route update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, and conflict plans through coordinator/fuse. Preserve successful effects and recover rollback by re-observation.
3. Defer remaining matching plans with scope/reason/`retry_not_before`; let independent scopes continue.
4. Preserve exact applied/failed/deferred/skipped/recovered tallies and nonzero degraded-pass signaling.
5. Replay the sanitized 1,200-run completed GitHub Actions slice. Count only normalized terminal outcomes, never warning/grep text, and prove zero premature termination of observed successful/partial work.

## Testing
Verified-fake batches assert wire order/call ceilings/tallies/logs/exit. Historical replay names any counterfactual stop and blocks if it predates observed later success.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Each non-create family has one coordinator route and one internal legacy rollback value with no dual-send.
- [x] Venue-gated Cloud/DC verified fakes pass before the coordinator default changes.
- [x] Matching remaining work is deferred with exact scope, reason, and `retry_not_before`, while independent scopes continue.
- [x] Applied, failed, deferred, skipped, and recovered tallies plus degraded exit status are exact.
- [x] Migrated families route failure fusing through the new endpoint-failure scoped fuse; legacy ad-hoc retry nesting is unreachable for them and the blast-radius mass-mutation guard remains in force.
- [x] Historical replay of the completed 1,200-run slice shows zero premature stop before observed successful or partially successful work.

## Out of scope
Create coordination remains S4; final legacy removal remains S5.
## Impacted sites (existing dispatch seams the cutover rewires)
Routes the S3 T1 coordinator + T2 fuse into real non-create dispatch behind the landed per-family selector; additive, never dual-send. (Wiring detail: see "Reuse the landed cutover surface" below.)
- `applier.py` (**784 LOC — 16 under the 800 cap; MUST NOT grow past 800**): `_apply_batch` (:538)/`_apply_one` (:727) dispatch non-create families today. Gains ONLY a thin per-family route branch; net-new adapter lands in `batch_dispatch.py`.
- `dispatch_apply_phases.py` (694): legacy ad-hoc nested `_call_with_retry` (:76) becomes UNREACHABLE for migrated families (they fuse through `pass_fuse` via `coordinate_and_fuse`).
- `batch_dispatch.py` (361): landed cutover surface (`route_for`/`coordinate_and_fuse`/`CutoverReport`/`build_pass_tally`) — consumed and extended with the guard-hosting `execute` adapter + outcome→manifest mapper.
- `coordinator.py`/`pass_fuse.py` (S3 T1/T2), `classify.check_blast_radius` (blast-radius guard, DISTINCT from the fuse, retained in force AC5) — consumed as-is.
- `tests/fixtures/reconciler/rp03_fuse_completed_slice.json`: sanitized synthetic 1,200-run completed slice; replay counts only normalized terminal outcomes and shows zero premature stop (AC6).

Create coordination (S4) and final legacy removal (S5) stay out of scope.

## Guard preservation on the coordinator route (G6)
`coordinator.coordinate(ticket_plans, *, execute, locate, budget_factory)` is a PURE decision core (zero I/O, no clock); its injected `execute(plan, mutation)` closure is the SOLE side-effect channel, invoked ONCE per mutation in dependency order. Every legacy `_apply_batch` guard is preserved by hosting it at the SAME point relative to each physical invocation — none is lost to the pure core.

Per-mutation guards → inside the `execute` closure, before each dispatch (same order as the legacy loop, applier.py:658-662):
- Lost-lease `abort_check()` (applier.py:660): called FIRST in the closure — a lost ref-lock lease still raises `ReconcileLockLost` before any routed mutation issues.
- HEAD-drift recheck (`_recheck_drift`, applier.py:697 via :662): the closure re-pins HEAD + runs the same benign-tolerant check before each mutation; hostile drift still raises `HeadDriftError`. Head-pin state threads through the closure, not the core.
- rebar-id audit: the closure delegates each op to the existing per-call `dispatch_one`, which stamps the `rebar-id:<local_id>` label (dispatch_one.py:153/:247) — provenance unchanged.

Batch-precondition guards → on the full migrated set BEFORE `coordinate()`, fail-closed, exactly as `_apply_batch` today (applier.py:631):
- Cross-project guard (bug 626d, `_cross_project_targets` applier.py:231 via :631): offender refusal runs before any mutation issues; a cross-project target still fails closed.
- Blast-radius guard (`classify.check_blast_radius`): retained unchanged — DISTINCT from the fuse (AC5).

The core owns ONLY bucketing, dependency ordering, scope isolation and re-observation recovery; all imperative safety I/O stays in the closure/preconditions.

## Reuse the landed cutover surface (no new module)
The live reroute REUSES the already-landed pipeline in `batch_dispatch.py` — it adds NO parallel module. Enumerated landed surface consumed as-is:
- `route_for` (batch_dispatch.py:197): the per-family `coordinator|legacy` selector (non-create families default coordinator; `legacy` is the internal rollback value, AC1); the branch calls it.
- `coordinate_and_fuse` (batch_dispatch.py:294): accepts the injected `execute` closure, runs `coordinator.coordinate` then folds terminal outcomes through `pass_fuse`, returning `CutoverReport` (outcomes + five-bucket `tallies` + `fuse_decisions` + `degraded`). The reroute calls THIS; it is not reimplemented.
- `CutoverOutcome`/`CutoverReport`/`_fuse_one` (batch_dispatch.py:221/:235/:256) and `build_pass_tally` (:345): consumed for the outcome→live-tally/manifest mapping.

Net-new wiring (small, lands in batch_dispatch.py at 361 LOC — ample headroom — NOT applier.py):
1. An `execute(plan, mutation)` adapter builder that hosts the per-mutation `abort_check()` + HEAD-drift recheck (threading head-pin/concurrency/repo_root state) and delegates each physical op to the existing per-call dispatch (`dispatch_one`), preserving the `rebar-id:<local_id>` audit stamp.
2. A `CutoverReport`→manifest/five-bucket-tally mapper feeding the existing LIVE degraded-exit machinery (via `derive_pass_tally`).
`applier.py` `_apply_batch` gains ONLY a thin per-family branch: after the resident cross-project (bug 626d) + blast-radius batch preconditions, migrated families dispatch via `coordinate_and_fuse` with the adapter; non-migrated/create stay on the verbatim legacy loop. applier.py stays <800 LOC.

## Deferral metadata consumer + retirement
The fuse and its open scopes are PER-PASS, in-memory, zeroed each `reconcile_once` (S3 T2 contract) — deferral state is NOT persisted cross-process. A `scope_deferred` plan is simply not applied this pass; `scope`/`reason`/`retry_not_before` ride the deferral metadata as observability + the next pass's normal eligibility hint. The CONSUMER is the next reconcile pass's standard pending-work scan, which re-derives the plan from the store and re-evaluates it fresh; RETIREMENT is automatic (the in-memory scope evaporates at pass end). No new durable queue or cross-pass reader is introduced (that stays S4/S5 scope).

_apply_batch gains a thin per-family reroute branch: migrated non-create families route through batch_dispatch.coordinate_and_fuse (guarded execute preserves per-mutation abort_check + HEAD-drift + rebar-id audit + backstop), so the legacy _apply_one per-mutation loop (and thus dispatch_apply_phases._call_with_retry) is UNREACHABLE for them; cross-project bug-626d + blast-radius guards retained as batch preconditions. Stays <800 LOC.
derive_pass_tally consumer-side helper folding the 5-bucket cutover tally + degraded flag (extracted to respect reconcile.py 800-LOC cap).
_persist_and_log consumes the 5-bucket cutover tally (deferred/skipped/degraded) via derive_pass_tally.
run_pass_result exits non-zero on a degraded cutover pass (fuse opened) even with zero failures.

Held-out oracle: selector routing, live reroute wire/tally/defer/degraded, per-mutation abort_check/HEAD-drift preservation, cross-project bug-626d precondition, legacy-unreachable for migrated families, no dual-send, E2E.
Integrated fuse + historical replay counterfactual tests.
Exact degraded-pass 5-bucket tally + nonzero exit end-to-end regressions.
Sanitized synthetic 1,200-run completed historical outcome slice.
